title: Add per-file subtitle burn override
summary: Add a per-file queue override that burns exactly one selected subtitle track into the encoded video output while dropping selectable subtitle streams.
reason: Operators need a deliberate per-file subtitle burn-in path for files where selectable subtitles are not appropriate, without enabling broad folder or batch burn behavior.
behavior_before: Queue file overrides could keep, drop, strip, route, and tune output fields, but there was no approved per-file subtitle burn-in path. Existing engine burn vocabulary was not wired to an FFmpeg command builder.
behavior_after: A file override may save subtitles.burnTrack as one exact subtitle selector. The override forces encode, uses the current-style subtitle-burn encode profile, drops all selectable subtitle outputs, validates the selected stream exactly, and builds FFmpeg text-subtitle or bitmap-overlay burn graphs.
